title: Unlimited Opportunity
description: Ivanovich is getting ideas about what business might be done regarding those fallen meteorites...

mainQuestExcel.title: Unlimited Opportunity
mainQuestExcel.description: Ivanovich is getting ideas about what business might be done regarding those fallen meteorites...

dialogs.text: Hmm... Not bad. I could make quite a pile off this. But there's just one problem...
What problem might that be?
Eh? Oh, Traveler, it's you. You've come at just the right moment! Might I interest you in a... Let's call it a...
...a wonderful, mysterious, never-before-seen, surefire-profit of a business proposition?
I just need a little help from you, and we will both reap great rewards from it.
The Northland Bank is a maximum-security facility, you know.
Well, of course it is. Why, even the guards are from Snezhnaya. So... Wait, what? What were you thinking about?
It seems as though your travels have broadened your horizons — your thoughts are truly imaginative.
But my business proposition is one that is both realistic and down-to-earth.
I suppose you know of those meteorites that fell from the sky?
I want to find one of those meteorites, hack a few pieces off it, and bring them back.
Afterwards, we will hire an able craftsman to carve them into jewelry and ornaments...
Think about it. Ornaments made from a meteorite. Rings, necklaces, bracelets and earrings... Sure to fetch a fine price with the rich and wealthy.
Your part in this is simple, Traveler. You just need to make sure that my work remains undisturbed by monsters.
How about it? Do we have a deal?
You shouldn't go near those meteorites.
What? Why not? I'm not letting this business opportunity pass me by.
Did you find something new in Liyue's legal codices?
Um, honestly, Liyue's laws are very well written indeed. One can hardly find a single loophole in them.
*cough* B—But that's not the point! I always make sure to follow the law!
There will be a lot of monsters, you know.
I do, and that's what I'll need you for, Traveler.
I'm sure others have had this idea...
Why, of course — and that's precisely why we should make haste.
If you're willing to help, Traveler, let's set out at once.
Every second we spend shooting the breeze is Mora we could stand to lose!
Wow, we're not getting through to him at all, are we?
Maybe we can convince him that his scheme won't make money, or that the meteorites are really dangerous...
You'll faint if you touch those meteorites.
Hmm? Ah, yes, I'd heard that rumor. This could certainly pose a problem...
But I believe that there are machines that can resolve this issue... There should be, right?
Ooh, he's starting to come around. Is he... weighing the profits and losses of this scheme?
Let's keep it up. We've got to convince him that this venture won't make money and that the meteorites are super dangerous.
Are you sure you can find matching ornaments?
Oh, don't worry about that. I will find them one way or another.
Silver, gold, precious stones... I should be able to get any of those easily.
You're doing pretty well for yourself. There's no need to take risks.
Risks? Comrade, do you know what we say in Snezhnaya?
Pursue perfection, comrade, pursue perfection! We must never rest on our laurels.
Use ever more refined techniques, earn ever more Mora — that is how one should behave as a merchant.
Perhaps you could go to the Adventurers' Guild...
Ha! They rejected my commission, saying that "you shouldn't touch those meteorites."
Adventurers' Guild, my foot! There's hardly any spirit of adventure there.
Isn't that because they also find those meteorites dangerous?
Hmm... When you put it that way, it does make sense. But surely they can't be that dangerous...
Those meteorites are very heavy.
Ah, that's a small issue. I have already chartered us a vehicle. Surely those meteorites cannot cause even hot air balloons to stop moving.
Will the Millelith even let you go?
Oh, come now, dear comrade. We're not doing anything illegal.
Understand this: this shower of meteorites is a disaster indeed, but I plan to turn it into opportunity!
But the people who buy those ornaments will...
Agh, you're right... Even if I'm able to skirt the issue with machinery, those ornaments will need to be worn, won't they?
If my customers are rendered unconscious, that... might reflect poorly upon me.
Well, we could fashion it into a decoration that could be displayed far from anyone. But wouldn't that reduce the price significantly?
Hmm, this is tricky...
Alright, alright. I understand. You mean to dissuade me from touching those meteorites, don't you?
I don't think you'll accept this commission either, will you? Well, if you don't want to, it's fine.
It'll be difficult to hire more guards on short notice, yes.
But I won't give up! Even if I can't get my hands on a meteorite, I won't give this opportunity up so easily!
Well, Traveler, I may not be going to get a meteorite, but I'll need you to help me with something else.
If those meteorites really are so fascina— I mean, dangerous, that they can cause those who touch them to faint...
Then the things around those fallen meteorites must also have been affected.
Traveler, can you look for something in the area where they fell that you can bring back here? Plants, flowers... anything will do.
Got it...
Thank you. I simply cannot let such an opportunity slip by.
Is this what merchants are like?
Haha. I'll take that as a compliment. I'm counting on you, then.
Alright then, you both make very good points. The meteorites do seem too dangerous. I shan't endanger myself unnecessarily on their account.
Ah, but it still seems like such a shame to let such a huge opportunity go by like this...
I wonder if there's any way to turn these meteorites that render people unconscious into normal rock...
Hmm, no, that's not right. If they turn back into normal rocks, there'd be no profit to be made...

flow.stepDescription: Give the Sweet Flower to Ivanovich

dialogs.text: Have you found anything?
I did.
Wonderful! Let me see.
Ah, a fresh Sweet Flower. Not bad at all. It is indeed abnormal. This must be the influence of the meteorites...
That might be problematic.
Hmm? What do you mean?
You were attacked while gathering flowers by... flowers? There are flowers that attack people?
Aha, that must be the meteorites' influence! That would explain why those flowers are so special.
I'm not sure there's a relation there...
That's right! What do meteorites have to do with flowers, anyway?
No, no, no, believe me. This flower is most certainly special in some way.
There's nothing special about this flower, though...
No, comrades, no. It was found beside one of those meteorites, so of course there's something special about it.
But this Sweet Flower doesn't look, smell, or feel any different from ordinary ones.
Well, as for that... that's not something you need to worry about.
Here's your compensation, as we agreed. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
Now, how to use this Sweet Flower... In a perfume, or as a bookmark? Perhaps it might even be good dried...
